claims: The Artemis II mission launches at approximately 17,000 mph (27,358 km/h).
The Artemis II mission reaches orbit before accelerating to over 24,500 mph (39,400 km/h).
The Artemis II mission accelerates to over 24,500 mph (39,400 km/h) to leave Earth's orbit for the Moon.
Upon returning, the Orion capsule hits Earth's atmosphere at roughly 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h).
